contexts.text: This outermost is called the circuit.
In the Word are mentioned the midst and the circuit. When Canaan is treated of... the circuit was where the surrounding nations were.

With man... from the inmost the Lord rules those things which are in his circuits; and when man suffers the Lord to dispose the circuits to correspondence with the inmost things, he is in a state in which he can receive Heaven... But when the man does not suffer the Lord to dispose the circuits to correspondence, the man recedes from Heaven in the same proportion.
The body is in the circuit...
Those who are in the circuits of Heaven...
On the circuit of evil. SE 2776.
A rainbow round about the throne () = Divine truth round about.
Six wings about him () = the Divine Spiritual around it.
The circuit () = that which is outside or below.
The circuits of Jerusalem () = truths of doctrine in the natural man.
The circuits of the hill of Jehovah () = all who are in truths of doctrine and thence in the good of charity.
Gathered from every side () = all in whatever state...
